nodes.label: docs/canon/DESIGN_HISTORY.md — how this system was actually designed and built, 2026-05-07 → 2026-08-03. One timeline fused from two independent forensic records plus the verbatim user canon; nothing in it is new research and nothing is a new conclusion — every statement already exists in a source record and arrives with the citation that record carries

The three sources and what each can settle. raw/git_record.md covers 2026-05-07 → 08-01 in 74 commits, 30 refs and 91 `git show` reproduce commands, and settles what existed when, what changed, what was deleted, and whether a later state contradicts an earlier one — never who wrote prose. raw/desktop_docs_record.md covers 2026-05-25 → 07-12 in 20 desktop-only agent-written handoff/state docs, 6,719 lines and ~150 recovered user quotes, and settles the decision conversations git cannot see — second-hand, an agent's report of a conversation. USER_CANON.md covers 803 verbatim human turns 05-14 → 08-03 plus 80 recovered rulings, and settles what the user actually said. Both raw records stay on disk untouched as evidence; this file reorders them, it does not replace them

The citation rule and the authorship labels. Every statement keeps the evidence its source record carried: a git claim carries its `git show <ref>:<path>` command exactly as git_record.md gives it, a docs claim carries the desktop doc's filename + heading, and a user quote carries date + the quote. A claim without its citation is a defect — a bug in the file, not a licence to repeat it. Labels kept from both records: from git_record.md [USER] (first-person design voice, terse human commit register), [AGENT] (AI footer, or the mechanical `feat: update <dir> (N files)` tooling format), [UNKNOWN] (undecidable from git — most May/June prose); from desktop_docs_record.md [USER-STATED], [USER-STATED — paraphrase], [AGENT-ASSERTED], [UNCLEAR]

Precedence when the two records disagree about who decided something: first-hand chat > git blob > agent-written doc. A [CHAT] turn in USER_CANON.md outranks everything. A git blob proves a thing existed but can never attribute prose. An agent-written state doc is the only attribution evidence for the two chat blackouts (05-16 → 05-26 and 05-29 → 06-26) and is used as such — labelled second-hand, never upgraded silently. Where the records genuinely disagree, both readings appear and the better-evidenced one is named; the unsettled ones are collected at the end

The era map, each era carrying What was decided / What was built / What diverged. Era 1, 05-07 → 05-24 — Frames and facets: the system arrives fully designed, and starts shedding parts. Era 2, 05-25 → 06-14 — The v2 rebuild pivot: references not copies, and the weights stop being emitted. Era 3, 06-15 → 06-28 — Facet reconciliation and the v3 harness: the spec that was never built. Era 4, 06-28 → 07-12 — The native artefact build, and its condemnation by its own author. Era 5, 07-13 → 07-28 — The v1 retrieval engineering era: the forensic arm becomes the product. Era 6, 07-29 → 08-03 — Audit, corpus, tag-first, and the canon audit that produced these records. 06-28 is a hinge day and appears in two eras

Era 1, 2026-05-07 → 05-24 — Frames and facets. Evidence asymmetry stated up front: the desktop doc corpus begins 05-25 so it cannot witness this era, and USER_CANON.md records its first surviving human turn on 05-14, so almost everything rests on git alone and prose authorship is correspondingly undecidable. Decided: the system arrives fully designed; the original graph spine; the controlled canonical vocabulary; the cluster-dimension rename (05-11, [USER]); interpretation frames — the model must not see pipeline machinery; the tagging contract's five-facet scoring schema; the query interpretation layer and prompt/chunk symmetry; the full-HERB pilot as the empirical basis. Diverged: the canonical vocabulary deleted with no mention (C-3); two extra scoring factors arriving between design and ship (C-12); the jockedev2 RAGAS series squashed away (C-11); two undefended constants going into 255,288 edges (C-15)

Era 2, 2026-05-25 → 06-14 — The v2 rebuild pivot. Decided: the 05-25 weight/retrieval redesign and the live audit that shelved it, which is the empirical basis for everything after; 05-30 the v2 pivot to references, not copies; 06-01 the three-tier semantic model; 06-03/06-04 chunking and the cap; 06-09 weights are measured, not emitted; 06-11 the re-cut — phrase nodes, no description, and the build gate; 06-12 the spine closes; 06-14 facets as relevance channels and the thesis is done. Diverged: the shipped v1 scorer's seven factors and five hard gates (05-28); D10 never retracted in place (C-1); the SQL-agent baseline adopted then silently un-adopted; the five-facet set entering as an agent synthesis and being treated as canon

Era 3, 2026-06-15 → 06-28 — Facet reconciliation and the v3 harness. Decided: 06-15 the largest design landing in the repo; the closed graph spine; the chunking design as coherent episodes; the mapping key; structural oracle quarantine; the v2 facet set and per-facet specs — the spec that was never built; the retrieval routing model; model contracts as a working draft with nine unsigned items; the three-arm eval harness (06-18 → 06-23); arm independence and comment hygiene (06-23); the lucene baseline (06-21); 06-25's three documents in one day; 06-27 when the chat record resumes. Built: the tagger, with facets abandoned (06-28), and the fourth facet set — the content profile (06-27). Diverged: the per-facet extraction spec fully written and never built (C-7); DESIGN.md contradicting itself at the same commit (C-9); three tagger-model decisions with the third undocumented (C-10); the leaderboard-comparable anchor metric specced, stubbed, then deleted (C-17); design-bearing changes hidden under tooling commit messages (C-18)

Era 4, 2026-06-28 → 07-12 — The native artefact build, and its condemnation. Decided: the 06-28 123-turn session, reconstructed turn-by-turn; what pass 1 actually is, from the code record; the pass-1 result as [AGENT-ASSERTED] on gold-100 at k=10, retrieval-only; 06-30 / 07-01 pass 2 — dials, the curve, and the relationships pivot; 07-06 the v1 arm revived, renamed and restated; 07-12 the state of things and the artefact_v1 audit. Diverged: C-7 resolved here in the four-step bridge from spec to flat list; C-2's causal chain completing, with the contradiction not yet existing; the canon going stale on 06-28 with the staleness logged the same day (C-14); and everything specified in this era and never built

Era 5, 2026-07-13 → 07-28 — The v1 retrieval engineering era: the forensic arm becomes the product. Decided: 07-15 the four-point rejection of the gate; 07-16 trust revoked, and the terminal becomes canon; 07-17 → 07-24 the usage catastrophes; 07-20 → 07-21 the vocabulary is reclaimed; 07-22 orchestrator mode and the adversarial panel; 07-23 normalization, the hybrid arm, and commit-means-push; 07-25 → 07-26 what the score is for, and which artefact is which; 07-28 the graph question again, and the full revert. Built: the shipped artefact arm. Diverged: three canon rules and the arm that ships now disagree at HEAD, plus what git cannot supply for this era

Era 6, 2026-07-29 → 08-03 — Audit, corpus, tag-first. Decided: 07-29 held-out generalization on his terms; 07-30 what tags are for; 07-31 the fullest clustering specification, and a reversal; 08-01 tags-first ships and is immediately rejected; 08-02 gold-blindness and the canon audit; 08-03 the two machines' history is merged. Diverged: the full revert took the matched-budget work with it; cluster-K has never been on the load-bearing path; the arbitrary constants he predicted, unenumerated; and the graph question, asked seven times, never answered

The eighteen contradictions, adjudicated. C-numbers are fixed at discovery in raw/git_record.md and kept unchanged so existing references resolve; git_record.md's own by-importance reading order is C-1 · C-2 · C-3 · C-4 · C-5 · C-6 · C-7 · C-8 · C-9 · C-10 · C-11 · C-12 · C-16 · C-17 · C-18 · C-13 · C-14 · C-15. Each entry gives the git evidence, the desktop-docs verdict and one line of resolved status, with the verdict vocabulary CONFIRMS / REFUTES / EXPLAINS / PARTLY EXPLAINS / NEITHER taken from desktop_docs_record.md §4

C-1 to C-5 and their resolved status. C-1 D10 reversed, content-in-graph → references-only: documented reversal — leaving D10 "Active" is the user's own frozen-v1-docs policy ("that shit is still true for THAT build", [DOC] 06-12). C-2 the v2 design declared all v1 eval numbers invalid while the shipped arm is the v1 graph: user decision misread as drift, which then became genuine drift — the forensic-contrast ruling is documented and deliberate, and what nobody reconciled is the canon written as if v3 were the system under test; live at HEAD, and git calls it the largest live contradiction in the repo. C-3 the controlled canonical vocabulary deleted with no mention: genuine silent drop, with no user statement about it in any of the three sources. C-4 six of eight node labels and four of seven edge types gone: split — documented reversal for :NEXT (never populated), genuine silent drop for :TAGGED / weight_global. C-5 "the chunk description is dead" except in the arm that ships: user decision misread as drift — two true statements about two different systems

C-6 to C-12 and their resolved status. C-6 the condemned v1 facets returned under new names: documented reversal — twice, both user-driven, reconciliation still outstanding. C-7 the per-facet extraction spec fully written and never built: documented reversal, with tag.py's unargued docstring as the compressed trace. C-8 entity decomposition specified then reversed: documented reversal, attribution upgraded to the user. C-9 DESIGN.md contradicting itself in two places at the same commit: split — deliberate policy for §13, genuine unremoved residue for §9.5 and the rest. C-10 three tagger-model decisions, each superseding the last, the final one undocumented: split — documented reversal for rev 1→2 and the interpreter swap, silent for the last. C-11 six commits of measured results squashed away: genuine silent drop — of the record, not the knowledge. C-12 the "seven factors" claim: not a contradiction, verified correct by both records independently

C-13 to C-18 and their resolved status. C-13 "the model emits no numbers, ever" vs the arm that ships: user decision misread as drift — the numeric-facet code is kept. C-14 canon describing a build state that no longer exists: genuine silent drop — of the fix, not the finding. C-15 two constants that no artifact in git ever derives: not a contradiction — confirmed and enlarged; α and 0.50 remain underived. C-16 "no hard filters anywhere in ranking" written against a v1 that was full of them: documented reversal, attribution upgraded to a user stance. C-17 the leaderboard-comparable anchor metric specced, stubbed, then deleted: documented reversal — a user decision, not a silent drop. C-18 design-bearing changes routinely hidden under tooling commit messages: not a design contradiction — a record-keeping defect with an explained cause
